### Agenda

This call will kick off the SSZ Engine API breakout sessions.

The primary focus will be on the specification, testing, and implementation of the REST-SSZ Engine API layer, as well as coordinating the work required to bring the feature to production readiness and eventual adoption across the clients.

- Pre-readings

- Series intro

- Client team Updates

- Discuss Unifying [new-payload-with-witness](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/773#issuecomment-4798897437) with new engine api scheme

comments.body: Can we discuss unifying `new-payload-with-witness` with the new versioning engine API scheme? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/773#issuecomment-4798897437

I might not be able to join today, due to personal time conflicts.

I think we should discuss the following topics:
- Moving the fork into the header and out of the url
- Moving from `engine/v2/` down to `engine/v1/`
- Feedback from @nazarhussain
    - Repeated retrievals of Payloads via getPayload
    - Turning BlobsAndProofsV1 into Optional[BlobsAndProofsV1]

- Rollout 
    - How should this be rolled out
    - when
    - how much of a prio is this compared to Glamsterdam/Hegota (My personal opinion is that its much less of a prio)
As noted this should be moved to a biweekly-basis
